summary: This Form 8-K filed by Rithm Perpetual Life Residential Trust under Item 8.01 merely announces the per-share net asset values of its common share classes as of June 30, 2026. The filing provides Class J NAV of $20.1637 and Class E NAV of $20.2802, breaking down portfolio components such as residential loans, cash, and secured financings. There are no mergers, acquisitions, tender offers, capital returns, or any other special-situation corporate events disclosed. It is a routine periodic NAV reporting. No board recommendation, deal terms, or risk-arb angle applies. This is not a special situation; the filing functions as a standard periodic disclosure of fund-level performance metrics.
